scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: The input is a plausible, self-contained request with recoverable intent and consistent constraints. The output organizes it into a clear prompt without performing the task. It preserves the timing and line-break scope, special attention to continuing lyrics, unchanged names and wording, caption order, the prohibition on publishing photos and creating other materials, and file-only delivery for review before venue handoff. The fallback to returning the existing file when no changes are needed is also retained. No material defect found.

These omissions violate the /prompt requirement to preserve supplied requests and constraints.
